mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of an in-law suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an in-law suite addition is influenced by several factors, including its size, the quality of finishes, the complexity of structural changes, and the extent of utility connections (plumbing, electrical). For instance, adding a full kitchen will be more expensive than just a kitchenette. Homeowners in the Hometelligent Inc. service areas, such as Livermore or San Leandro, should consider how existing utility access affects costs, as extending these can add to the budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors for an in-law suite include size, finish quality, structural changes, and utility connections. Existing utility access can significantly impact the budget.
